privacy.question: Is my data private?
privacy.answer: Yes. Your study data is yours — you can export it anytime from Settings.

free.question: Is Study Line free to use?
free.answer: Yes, creating an account and tracking your studies is free.

offline.question: Does it work without internet?
offline.answer: Yes. Study Line keeps working offline and syncs your changes automatically once you're reconnected.

languages.question: What languages are supported?
languages.answer: Study Line is available in English and Arabic, including full right-to-left layout.
